gold_decisions.identity_explanation: The gold issue concerns an invalid uniform-in-time operator-power estimate and its telescoping growth factor. ISSUE-002 concerns incorrect threshold inclusions in a last-visit classification algorithm; it does not identify the temporal coherence estimate or its missing norm/spectral condition.

The gold issue is the failure to construct one perturbation consistent with all adaptive, precision-indexed queries and the resulting invalid transfer to F_1. ISSUE-002 diagnoses different numerical threshold errors in a classification proof and supplies no recognition of the all-query consistency obligation.

The gold issue concerns invalid transition-ratio bounds in the alternating-tail construction and failure to preserve membership in the interval input class. ISSUE-004 concerns a torus-map conjugacy and Fourier spectral argument, with no diagnosis of the tail-ratio invariant.

The gold issue is the nonexistent non-increasing rearrangement of a bounded sequence and the resulting unsupported spectral-radius bound. ISSUE-004 addresses noninjectivity and homotopy obstruction to a torus conjugacy, not sequence rearrangement or block-average estimates.

Both identify that for the skew product, nonzero mean-zero functions depending only on x are fixed eigenfunctions with eigenvalue 1. Thus the claimed absence of eigenfunctions in span{1} perpendicular is false; only exclusion of eigenvalues other than 1 can be supported.
gold_decisions.shared_mathematical_weakness: The skew-product construction leaves the x-coordinate invariant, so every nonzero mean-zero function of x is a nonconstant 1-eigenfunction. The proof cannot establish absence of all eigenfunctions in span{1} perpendicular or the corresponding weak-mixing claim.

component_coverage.gold_component: The claimed absence of nonconstant eigenfunctions in span{1} perpendicular is false because x-dependent mean-zero observables are fixed by the skew product.
component_coverage.recognition_explanation: The prediction gives the same x-dependent mean-zero eigenfunction counterexample and states the corrected spectral conclusion that only eigenvalue 1 remains.

gold_decisions.identity_explanation: Both identify that the symmetric degree-zero rotation function is not a circle homeomorphism and cannot conjugate the skew product to the nontrivial shear. The prediction also supplies the appropriate direct Fourier repair for the separate spectral conclusion.
gold_decisions.shared_mathematical_weakness: The asserted C0 conjugacy is impossible because the skew product has degree-zero, noninjective rotation data while the shear has nontrivial winding action; conjugate maps must have compatible induced actions.

component_coverage.gold_component: The claimed C0 conjugacy between the symmetric skew product and the shear is impossible because their circle-map degree/injectivity and induced winding actions differ.
component_coverage.recognition_explanation: The prediction explicitly identifies the differing rotation domains, noninjectivity caused by symmetry, and the resulting impossibility of a C0 conjugacy.
